title: Is Your Body Beach Ready?
paragraphs: It seems like summer is just around the corner! Have you been planning your beach days? Oh wait, has your routine gone for a toss while being at home all day! We understand covid-19 has affected us all at different levels. The pandemic made us realize the importance of simpler things that we took for granted, like relationships or simpler joys of life. The pandemic has turned lives upside down. Social isolation, staying at home, and limited social activities have encouraged people to become more inactive and lead a sedentary lifestyle. It has further affected your fitness levels as snacking and no physical activity means more weight. We understand how problematic it is when pockets of body fat do not go away.

Nowadays, technological advancements offer people choices that help them decide their best interests. It is an advantage for consumers as the cosmetic or aesthetic industry is ever-expanding. Many non-surgical body sculpting procedures are available to help you shape and contour your body. One such is Emsculpt, as it doesn’t serve as a weight loss solution but is suitable for people who have achieved their weight and want to reduce or remove stubborn fat. Excess fat resists any efforts you put in, like physical exercise or a balanced diet. It does not use hot or cold procedures; instead, high-intensity electromagnetic technology stimulates involuntary muscle contractions. It is more like an intense workout session. It is fast and convenient without causing any discomfort to the patient. It is suitable for many areas such as arms, abdomen, buttocks, thighs, and calves.

The growing popularity of Emsculpt is due to its fast and convenient method. It is a non-surgical procedure where you do not think about longer recovery times and extreme side effects. The minimum side effect can be skin soreness. Emsculpt is an easy and highly convenient procedure that gives you success in areas you’ve just been thinking about. So, without any hassle or stress of longer recovery times, your body can become beach-ready this summer.

Suppose you gained some extra pounds from snacking, and no physical activity during the pandemic worsened your stubborn areas. In that case, you should consider reaching out to Marin Medical Aesthetics for this convenient and non-invasive procedure. Schedule an appointment at (415) 785-4604 today.
